observations.headerText:
MATRX EXTEND DEMO

A clear three-stage browser workflow

This stable sample page lets anyone try Matrx Extend without signing in. The page contains a real article, useful links, a structured table, and JSON-LD metadata so the extension's page-aware features have predictable material to work with.

interpretation: The live Chrome DOM header containing the visible source H1 matches header:not(:has(p + p)):not(:has(img)). It contains two paragraphs, but they are not adjacent p siblings, and contains no img. This supports the selector-based removal hypothesis for this exact public demo DOM; it does not execute Defuddle or prove its output, the extraction/render path, or a product fix.
coverage: Single read-only public demo DOM observation; no extension extraction, saved-capture, model, or candidate build behavior tested.
cleanup: No Chrome pins, profile state, or page state changed; guard stopped after UI work.
